exact_statement: For every W, b and tau in [0, 2/||W||_2^2], F(x)=x-tau W^T ReLU(Wx+b) is an explicit Euler step and is 1-Lipschitz on R^d.
baseline_tested_scope: One d=1 identity instance with three hidden units.
reason: An identity at one point does not establish the universal Lipschitz quantifiers.
